acvram ne fait que servir le modèle (API: acvram only serves the model (OpenAI API, port {port}). For it to read files, run commands or administer the machine you need an agent: a program that receives its replies, executes the tools it asks for (shell, files) and sends the result back. Example below: acvram + Qwen3-Coder + OpenClaw on Ubuntu.
Servir un modèle qui sait appeler des ou: Serve a model that knows how to call tools (Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, GLM-4.7-Flash…): Server tab, max context ≥ 16384, port {port}. acvram passes the request's tools to the model's template and returns tool_calls (OpenAI).
Installer l'agent : OpenClaw (<code>~/.l: Install the agent: OpenClaw (~/.local/bin/openclaw, Node ≥ 26) or any OpenAI-compatible agent (Open Interpreter, Aider, Continue…). It runs as your user, never root.
Déclarer acvram comme fournisseur de l'a: Declare acvram as the agent's provider: openclaw configure → custom provider, API openai-completions, base http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1, any key (acvram does not check it), model acvram, context window = the server's.
Donner les outils système à l'agent : pr: Give the agent the system tools: tools profile full (shell, files, local network) in openclaw.json, a dedicated workspace (workspace) where it may write, and a confirmation before any destructive command.
Lancer : <code>openclaw gateway start</c: Run: openclaw gateway start (user service) then openclaw chat (terminal) or openclaw agent -m "list the files in ~/Documents and summarise them". The model answers with tool calls, the agent executes them on Ubuntu, the model reads the results and carries on.
Vérifier : <code>openclaw doctor</code>: Check: openclaw doctor (gateway, provider, tools); in the acvram console, the server's regime line and the /v1/chat/completions requests coming from the agent.
Prudence : un modèle local qui a le shel: Caution: a local model with a shell has all your rights. Keep the agent under an ordinary user, a bounded workspace, backups, and read what it proposes before accepting an rm, sudo or network command. A model not trained for tools (pure chat) will return text instead of calls: pick a recent “instruct” model.

acvram ne fait que servir le modèle (API: acvram only serves the model (OpenAI API, port {port}). To chat with it, attach images or give it tools, you need a client: here Open WebUI, a free web interface that speaks the OpenAI API and runs on your machine. Example below: acvram + Open WebUI on Ubuntu.
Servir un modèle : onglet Serveur, port: Serve a model: Server tab, port {port}. For images, pick an alias marked 👁 (vision tower served); for tools, a recent “instruct” model (Qwen3-Coder, GLM-4.7-Flash…).
Installer et lancer Open WebUI (<code>pi: Install and start Open WebUI (pip install open-webui in a Python 3.12 environment, then open-webui serve --port 3000, or the official Docker image): it opens at http://127.0.0.1:3000; the first account created is the administrator.
Brancher acvram : Open WebUI → Réglages: Connect acvram: Open WebUI → Settings → Connections → OpenAI → add a connection: URL http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1, key acvram-local (acvram does not check the key, but Open WebUI requires one). Save: the model acvram/acvram appears in the model selector.
Discuter : nouvelle conversation, modèle: Chat: new conversation, model acvram/acvram. On a 👁 alias, the paperclip attaches an image (PNG, JPEG, WebP): Open WebUI sends it as image_url, acvram passes it to the vision tower and the server's regime line says vision=bf16(eager,…); on a text alias, the request is refused by name (400 “model without vision tower”), never ignored.
Outils et agents : Open WebUI porte ses: Tools and agents: Open WebUI has its own tools (search, code, files); for a system agent (shell, files), any OpenAI-compatible agent connects to the same /v1 URL — it runs as your user, never root.
Vérifier : dans la console acvram, la li: Check: in the acvram console, the server's regime line and the /v1/chat/completions requests coming from Open WebUI; in Open WebUI, Settings → Connections → “Verify connection” must answer.
Prudence : un modèle local qui reçoit de: Caution: a local model given tools has all your rights. Keep the agent under an ordinary user, a bounded workspace, backups, and read what it proposes before accepting an rm, sudo or network command. Open WebUI listens only on 127.0.0.1 by default: do not expose it without authentication.
